title: Livy, History of Rome 37.38–44 and 45.12 (trans. W. A. McDevitte)

verification_log.method: Downloaded the Gutenberg text (books 37 to the end)

Book 37 (consuls L. Cornelius Scipio and C. Laelius): Antiochus camps near Magnesia at Sipylus; the army routed, 44: up to 50,000 foot and 3,000 horse said killed; 45.12: Roman envoys met Antiochus at Eleusine four miles from Alexandria; Popilius drew a line round the king with a wand; he replied "I will do as the senate directs"
